-- Operates on authored, inspectable UI. Does not create or own gameplay state.
local Layout = {}
function Layout.Apply(root, size, menuOpen, offersOpen)
    local w,h=size.X,size.Y
    local full=w>=1100 and h>=650
    local top=root.TopRow
    local head=top.LevelHeader
    local offer=top.MultiplierOffer
    if full then
        local headerW=math.min(720,w*.47)
        top.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(headerW+214,90)
        top.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,10)
        head.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(headerW,54)
        head.LevelBadge.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(132,54)
        head.ProgressTrack.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(139,6)
        head.ProgressTrack.Size=UDim2.new(1,-145,0,42)
        head.LevelBadge.Label.TextSize=29
        head.ProgressTrack.ProgressText.TextSize=28
        offer.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(headerW+14,0)
        offer.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(200,76)
        offer.Label.TextSize=24
        offer.Price.TextSize=23
        offer.Multiplier.TextSize=24
        head.Remaining.TextSize=17
    else
        local groupW=math.min(w-24,700)
        local offerW=w<540 and 104 or 154
        local headerW=groupW-offerW-10
        top.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(groupW,82)
        top.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,8)
        head.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(headerW,42)
        local badgeW=w<540 and 76 or 100
        head.LevelBadge.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(badgeW,42)
        head.ProgressTrack.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(badgeW+5,5)
        head.ProgressTrack.Size=UDim2.new(1,-badgeW-10,0,32)
        head.LevelBadge.Label.TextSize=w<540 and 18 or 23
        head.ProgressTrack.ProgressText.TextSize=w<540 and 17 or 23
        offer.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(headerW+10,0)
        offer.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(offerW,59)
        offer.Label.TextSize=w<540 and 15 or 19
        offer.Price.TextSize=w<540 and 16 or 19
        offer.Multiplier.TextSize=w<540 and 17 or 22
        head.Remaining.TextSize=w<540 and 12 or 14
    end
    local grid=root.MenuGrid
    local toggle=root.MenuToggle
    root:SetAttribute("LayoutMode",full and "Full" or "Compact")
    toggle.Visible=not full
    toggle.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,94)
    grid.Visible=full or menuOpen
    grid.BackgroundTransparency=1
    local cols,cellW,cellH,gap
    if full then
        cols,cellW,cellH,gap=2,82,h<740 and 78 or 88,8
        grid.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(16,math.max(100,math.min(h*.15,h-(cellH*4+24)-212)))
    elseif w>=700 then
        cols,cellW,cellH,gap=4,62,68,7
        grid.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,194)
    else
        cols,cellW,cellH,gap=2,62,68,7
        grid.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,194)
    end
    local rows=math.ceil(8/cols)
    grid.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(cols*cellW+(cols-1)*gap,rows*cellH+(rows-1)*gap)
    grid.Grid.CellSize=UDim2.fromOffset(cellW,cellH)
    grid.Grid.CellPadding=UDim2.fromOffset(gap,gap)
    grid.Grid.FillDirectionMaxCells=cols
    for _,tile in grid:GetChildren()do
        if tile:IsA("TextButton")then
            tile.Label.TextSize=full and 19 or 15
            tile.Icon.Size=UDim2.new(1,-10,1,-23)
            tile.Label.Size=UDim2.new(1,-2,0,full and 25 or 21)
        end
    end
    local resources=root.ResourceList
    if full then
        resources.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,1)
        resources.Position=UDim2.new(0,16,1,-20)
        resources.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(282,168)
        resources.List.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
        resources.List.Padding=UDim.new(0,6)
        for _,row in resources:GetChildren()do if row:IsA("Frame")then
            row.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(282,52)
            row.Icon.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(62,62)
            row.Label.Visible=false
            row.Value.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(62,0)
            row.Value.Size=UDim2.new(1,-68,1,0);row.Value.TextSize=42
        end end
    else
        local total=math.min(w-28,500)
        local rw=math.floor((total-12)/3)
        resources.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,0)
        resources.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,79)
        resources.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(total,34)
        resources.List.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
        resources.List.Padding=UDim.new(0,6)
        for _,row in resources:GetChildren()do if row:IsA("Frame")then
            row.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(rw,34)
            row.Icon.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(38,38)
            row.Label.Visible=false
            row.Value.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(34,0)
            row.Value.Size=UDim2.new(1,-39,1,0);row.Value.TextSize=w<540 and 23 or 28
        end end
        toggle.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,124)
    end
    local offers=root.PowerOffers
    root.OffersToggle.Visible=not full
    root.OffersToggle.Position=UDim2.new(1,-14,0,124)
    offers.Visible=full or offersOpen
    local ow=full and 178 or 160
    local oh=full and 132 or 120
    offers.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(ow,oh*3+20)
    offers.Position=full and UDim2.new(1,-16,.5,0)or UDim2.new(1,-14,0,194)
    offers.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,full and .5 or 0)
    offers.List.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
    if not full and w>=700 and h<460 then
        local total=math.min(w-28,500)
        ow=math.floor((total-20)/3)
        oh=math.min(106,h-214)
        offers.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(total,oh)
        offers.List.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    elseif not full then
        oh=math.clamp(math.floor((h-238)/3),78,120)
        offers.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(ow,oh*3+20)
    end
    for _,tile in offers:GetChildren()do if tile:IsA("TextButton")then
        tile.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(ow,oh)
        tile.Label.TextSize=full and 38 or 32
        tile.Price.TextSize=full and 24 or 21
    end end
    root.Status.Guide.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(600,w-48),26)
    root.Status.Guide.Visible=full
    root.Status.Toast.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(620,w-30),48)
    root.Status.Toast.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,full and 102 or 116)
    root.Status.Target.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(600,w-30),32)
    root.Status.Target.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,1,-(full and 76 or 50))
    root.ReturnToCamp.Position=UDim2.new(1,-16,1,-(full and 45 or 16))
    root.ReturnToCamp.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(full and 132 or 114,32)
    root.PreviewNote.Visible=full
    return full
end
return Layout

-- Edit-time, reusable native GUI artwork. No image uploads or runtime particles.
local Decor={}
local function frame(name,parent,size,position,z)
    local o=Instance.new("Frame");o.Name=name;o.BorderSizePixel=0
    o.Size=size;o.Position=position;o.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
    o.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);o.ZIndex=z or 2;o.Parent=parent
    return o
end
local function round(o)
    local c=Instance.new("UICorner");c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(.5,0);c.Parent=o
end
function Decor.Burst(parent)
    local glow=frame("RewardGlow",parent,UDim2.fromScale(.99,1.16),UDim2.fromScale(.5,.37),2)
    glow.BackgroundTransparency=1
    local aspect=Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint");aspect.AspectRatio=1;aspect.Parent=glow
    for i=1,8 do
        local d=.84-i*.075
        local core=frame("Core"..i,glow,UDim2.fromScale(d,d),UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5),2)
        core.BackgroundTransparency=.97-i*.012;round(core)
    end
    for i,angle in {0,45,90,135}do
        local ray=frame("Ray"..angle,glow,UDim2.fromScale(i%2==1 and 1 or .9,i%2==1 and .105 or .065),UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5),2)
        ray.Rotation=angle;round(ray)
        local fade=Instance.new("UIGradient");fade.Name="CenterToEdge"
        fade.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.16,.75),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.38,.15),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.5,0),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.62,.15),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.84,.75),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1),
        });fade.Parent=ray
    end
    return glow
end
function Decor.ResourceShade(parent)
    local shadow=frame("ResourceShade",parent,UDim2.fromScale(1,.84),UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5),2)
    shadow.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0);round(shadow)
    local fade=Instance.new("UIGradient");fade.Name="SoftSides"
    fade.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.16,.76),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.4,.48),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.6,.48),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.84,.76),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
    fade.Parent=shadow
    return shadow
end
return Decor

local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local GuiService=game:GetService("GuiService")
local shared=game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Theme=require(shared:WaitForChild("HUDTheme"))
local Layout=require(shared:WaitForChild("HUDLayout"))
local p=Players.LocalPlayer
local gui=p:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("MiningHUD")
local root=gui:WaitForChild("Root")
local connections={}
local menuOpen,offersOpen=false,false
local function connect(event,fn)table.insert(connections,event:Connect(fn))end
local function comma(value)
    local text=tostring(math.floor(tonumber(value)or 0))
    local result,n=text,0
    repeat result,n=result:gsub("^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)","%1,%2")until n==0
    return result
end
local function refresh()
    root.ResourceList.BackpackRow.Value.Text=comma(p:GetAttribute("Ore")).." / "..comma(p:GetAttribute("Capacity")or 5)
    root.ResourceList.CurrencyRow.Value.Text=comma(p:GetAttribute("Coins"))
    root.ResourceList.RebirthRow.Value.Text=comma(p:GetAttribute("Rebirths"))
    local head=root.TopRow.LevelHeader
    head.Power.Text="力量 "..comma(p:GetAttribute("Power")or 1)
    local live=p:GetAttribute("Level")~=nil and p:GetAttribute("XP")~=nil and p:GetAttribute("NextXP")~=nil
    local level=live and p:GetAttribute("Level")or Theme.Preview.Level
    local xp=live and p:GetAttribute("XP")or Theme.Preview.XP
    local maximum=math.max(1,live and p:GetAttribute("NextXP")or Theme.Preview.NextXP)
    head.LevelBadge.Label.Text="等级 "..comma(level)
    head.ProgressTrack.ProgressText.Text=comma(xp).." / "..comma(maximum)
    head.ProgressTrack.Fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(xp/maximum,0,1),1)
    head.Remaining.Text="还差 "..comma(math.max(0,maximum-xp)).." 升级"..(live and ""or " · 示例")
    head:SetAttribute("UsesPreviewProgress",not live)
end
local function resize()
    root.MenuToggle.Label.Text=menuOpen and "收起"or "菜单"
    root.OffersToggle.Label.Text=offersOpen and "收起"or "礼包"
    Layout.Apply(root,root.AbsoluteSize,menuOpen,offersOpen)
end
local notice=0
local function preview(message)
    notice+=1;local id=notice
    root.Status.Toast.Text=message
    task.delay(2.2,function()if gui.Parent and notice==id and root.Status.Toast.Text==message then root.Status.Toast.Text=""end end)
end
connect(root.MenuToggle.Activated,function()
    menuOpen=not menuOpen;offersOpen=false
    root.MenuToggle.Label.Text=menuOpen and "收起"or "菜单";resize()
end)
connect(root.OffersToggle.Activated,function()
    offersOpen=not offersOpen;menuOpen=false
    root.OffersToggle.Label.Text=offersOpen and "收起"or "礼包";resize()
end)
for _,item in Theme.Menus do
    connect(root.MenuGrid[item.Id].Activated,function()preview(item.Label.." · 界面展示，功能稍后接入")end)
end
for _,tile in root.PowerOffers:GetChildren()do
    if tile:IsA("TextButton")then connect(tile.Activated,function()preview("力量礼包展示 · 暂未开放购买")end)end
end
connect(root.TopRow.MultiplierOffer.Activated,function()preview("双倍力量展示 · 暂未开放购买")end)
local tweens={}
for _,button in root:GetDescendants()do
    if button:IsA("TextButton")then
        local base=button.BackgroundColor3
        local function animate(amount)
            if tweens[button]then tweens[button]:Cancel()end
            if button.BackgroundTransparency==1 then return end
            local color=amount>=0 and base:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),amount)or base:Lerp(Theme.Colors.Ink,-amount)
            if GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled then button.BackgroundColor3=color;return end
            local tween=TweenService:Create(button,TweenInfo.new(.1),{BackgroundColor3=color})
            tweens[button]=tween;tween:Play()
        end
        connect(button.MouseEnter,function()animate(.1)end)
        connect(button.MouseLeave,function()animate(0)end)
        connect(button.InputBegan,function(input)
            if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then animate(-.12)end
        end)
        connect(button.InputEnded,function(input)
            if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then animate(0)end
        end)
    end
end
for _,key in {"Ore","Capacity","Coins","Power","Rebirths","Level","XP","NextXP"}do connect(p:GetAttributeChangedSignal(key),refresh)end
connect(root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"),resize)
connect(script.Destroying,function()
    for _,connection in connections do connection:Disconnect()end
    for _,tween in tweens do tween:Cancel()end
end)
refresh();resize();gui.Enabled=true
task.spawn(function()
    local images={}
    for _,o in root:GetDescendants()do if o:IsA("ImageLabel")then table.insert(images,o)end end
    local ok,err=pcall(function()game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(images)end)
    if not ok then warn("MiningHUD icon preload: "..tostring(err))end
end)

require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("MiningAnimator")).Start()
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Run=game:GetService("RunService")
local p=Players.LocalPlayer
local wire=game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DigCamp")
local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.PrototypeConfig)
local camp=workspace:WaitForChild("Gem Gulch")
local gui=p:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("FieldKit")
gui:ClearAllChildren()
gui.ResetOnSpawn=false
local FeedbackEffects = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MiningFeedback)
local feedbackEffects = FeedbackEffects.new(gui,p)
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local hud=p:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("MiningHUD"):WaitForChild("Root")
local guide=hud.Status.Guide
local toast=hud.Status.Toast
local targetText=hud.Status.Target
hud.ReturnToCamp.Activated:Connect(function()wire.ReturnToCamp:FireServer()end)
local function refresh()
    local training=p:GetAttribute("TrainingGain")or 0
    local count=p:GetAttribute("Ore")or 0
    local mining=p:GetAttribute("AutoMining")==true
    guide.Text=count>=5 and "背包满了 · 返回摊位，走进绿色光幕出售" or training>0 and "正在自动敲矿训练 · 离开光幕即可停止" or mining and "正在自动采矿 · 走开即可停止" or "点击 +1 力量  ·  走进左侧练习区自动敲击  ·  靠近矿门自动挖掘"
    for i=1,#cfg.Layers do
        local layer=camp.Mine:FindFirstChild("Layer"..i)
        if layer then
            local hp=p:GetAttribute("Gate"..i.."HP")or cfg.Layers[i].WallHealth
            layer.Gate.CanCollide=hp>0
            layer.Gate.CanQuery=hp>0
            layer.Gate.LocalTransparencyModifier=hp==0 and 1 or 0
            for _,part in layer:GetChildren()do
                if part.Name=="Gate seam"then part.LocalTransparencyModifier=hp==0 and 1 or 0 end
            end
            layer["Gate label"].Lettering.Title.Text=hp==0 and ("第 "..i.." 层 · "..cfg.Layers[i].Name.."\n稀有矿 "..math.round(cfg.Layers[i].RareChance*100).."%")or ("第 "..i.." 层 · 岩壁 "..hp.."/"..cfg.Layers[i].WallHealth.."\n稀有矿 "..math.round(cfg.Layers[i].RareChance*100).."%")
        end
    end
end
for _,key in {"Power","TrainingGain","AutoMining","Coins","Ore","DeepestLayer"}do p:GetAttributeChangedSignal(key):Connect(refresh)end
for i=1,#cfg.Layers do p:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Gate"..i.."HP"):Connect(refresh)end
refresh()
local mouse=p:GetMouse()
local hovered
local function findTarget(part)
    if not part then return nil end
    if part:HasTag("MineTarget") or part:HasTag("TrainingTarget")then return part end
    local model=part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    local target=model and model:FindFirstChild("Target")
    return target and (target:HasTag("MineTarget") or target:HasTag("TrainingTarget")) and target or nil
end
local function send()
    wire.Practice:FireServer()
end
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed)
    if processed then return end
    if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
        feedbackEffects:ClickRing(UIS:GetMouseLocation()-inset)
        send()
    elseif input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.F or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX then send()end
end)
UIS.TouchTapInWorld:Connect(function(pos,processed)
    if processed then return end
    local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
    feedbackEffects:ClickRing(pos-inset)
    send()
end)
Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    hovered=findTarget(mouse.Target)
    if hovered and hovered:GetAttribute("TargetKind")=="Training" and targetText:GetAttribute("Busy")~=true then
        targetText.Text="走进光幕自动练习  ·  点击额外 +1 力量"
    elseif hovered and targetText:GetAttribute("Busy")~=true then
        local layer=hovered:GetAttribute("LayerIndex")
        local hp=hovered:GetAttribute("TargetKind")=="Gate" and p:GetAttribute("Gate"..layer.."HP")or hovered:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")
        targetText.Text=hp>0 and ("靠近自动敲击  ·  耐久 "..hp.."  ·  每次伤害 "..(p:GetAttribute("Power")or 1))or ""
    elseif not hovered and targetText:GetAttribute("Busy")~=true then targetText.Text=""end
end)
local noticeId=0
local function announce(value)
    noticeId+=1;local id=noticeId;toast.Text=value
    task.delay(2.2,function()if noticeId==id then toast.Text=""end end)
end
wire.Feedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(mode,a,b,c)
    if mode=="note"then announce(a)
    elseif mode=="sale"then announce("已售出 "..b.." 块矿石  +"..a.." 金币")
    elseif mode=="practice" then feedbackEffects:Power(b)
    elseif mode=="train" then feedbackEffects:Stroke(a,b,c)
    elseif mode=="hit"then
        feedbackEffects:Stroke(a,1,require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.MiningStyle).AutoSwingSpeed)
        targetText:SetAttribute("Busy",true);targetText.Text="剩余耐久 "..b.."/"..c
        task.delay(.5,function()targetText:SetAttribute("Busy",false)end)
    end
end)
local function view(character)
    local root=character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",10)
    if not root or p.Character~=character then return end
    task.wait(.2)
    local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
    cam.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position+Vector3.new(0,10,24),root.Position+Vector3.new(0,2,-5))
end
if p.Character then task.spawn(view,p.Character)end
p.CharacterAdded:Connect(view)
